chapter_seo_title: A Record of a Mortal's Journey – Chapter 525: Han Li Builds a Hidden Cave Amid Swallowing Sea Fish Fog
chapter_meta_description: Han Li escapes crowded Qiyuan Island to find a mist-shrouded island inhabited by Swallowing Sea Fish. He sets up a layered concealment formation and begins planning his next move.
og_title: Chapter 525 – The Island in the Mist
og_description: Han Li discovers a hidden island protected by demon-fish fog, carves a new cave dwelling, and studies a mysterious jade slip.
twitter_title: RMJI Ch. 525 – The fog island base arc begins!
twitter_description: Han Li buys a sea chart, dodges crowded cultivator zones, and finds a perfectly camouflaged island. Then comes a puzzle.

lore_anchors.definition: A medium-sized island in the Chaotic Star Sea; its only city is Blackstone City, and the surrounding waters are heavily marked with dangerous zones on sea charts.
A grade-one low-grade social demon beast covered in silver bone spines; they produce white mist by spitting seawater as a playful behavior, and large swarms can obscure entire islands.
Low-grade formation instruments that generate thick artificial mist; Han Li refined multiple sets and buried them around his island to merge with the natural sea fog for layered concealment.
A mysterious object inside a white jade box; Han Li retrieved it after studying the Inch of Gold Pavilion jade slip, but its purpose remains unknown.
A treasure and intelligence trading establishment in Blackstone City; Han Li previously acquired a jade slip there from an old merchant.
The only settlement on Qiyuan Island, a stone city that serves as a base for cultivators operating in the Chaotic Star Sea.
A grade-four demon beast that Han Li encountered and chased into the sea fog, inadvertently leading him to the hidden island.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why did Han Li fly north instead of toward the famous abyss?
cultural_notes_faq.a: He deliberately avoided the crowded cultivator zones near the abyss to minimize attention and find a more secluded base—classic Mortal Stream paranoia.

cultural_notes_faq.q: What are Swallowing Sea Fish and why are they useful here?
cultural_notes_faq.a: They are grade-one low-grade demon beasts that produce mist by spitting seawater. A massive swarm near this island creates natural fog cover, which Han Li then augments with artificial arrays to make the island nearly invisible.

cultural_notes_faq.q: What is in the white jade box Han Li looks at at the end?
cultural_notes_faq.a: The box contains five-colored small beads. Their purpose is not yet revealed, but they are connected to the jade slip from the Inch of Gold Pavilion—a clear set-up for a future plot development.
